segments.name: Lifestyle brand
segments.evidence: J.Jill is a national lifestyle brand that provides apparel, footwear and accessories designed to help its customers move through a full life with ease.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for apparel, footwear and accessories sold through J.Jill's retail stores, ecommerce platform and catalog, and the company also earns royalties from a third party's private label credit card program.
revenueModel.evidence: These royalties are based on an agreed-upon percentage of sales generated through the use of the private label credit card.
